name: Light’s Hope Chapel
shortDescription: Light’s Hope Chapel, a Classic-era setting in the Ras Frostwhisper research story.
body: This location appears in the Classic quest sequence. The Classic-to-Wrath chapel is a small, weathered timber building with a steep dark reddish-brown roof on the Eastern Plaguelands slope; it is not the later expanded stone fortress. Sparse bare trees, muted Plaguelands earth and a modest encampment frame the chapel. The scene is interpretive; the story-tour marker and theater staging assert no exact geographic coordinates.
